field.name: title
field.comment: The text displayed above the map

field.name: location
field.comment: The address the map is centered on, as the visitors read it

field.name: latitude
field.comment: The latitude the map is centered on, which Google Maps resolved the location to

field.name: longitude
field.comment: The longitude the map is centered on, which Google Maps resolved the location to

field.name: zoom
field.comment: How close the map is zoomed in, from 0 (the whole world) to 21 (a single building)

field.name: width
field.comment: The width of the map, as a CSS length (for instance 100% or 400px)

field.name: height
field.comment: The height of the map, as a CSS length (for instance 300px)

field.name: scrollwheel
field.comment: true: the visitors can zoom the map with the wheel of the mouse; false: the wheel scrolls the page

field.name: titleFormat
field.comment: The HTML element wrapping the text displayed above the map: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 or p
